# doughnut chart (save for advanced)

hsize \<-4

percents \<- mydata \|\> mutate( fraction = D1 / sum(D1), ymax = cumsum(fraction), ymin = c(0, head(ymax, -1)) )

ggplot(mydata, aes(x = hsize, y = D1_recode, fill = Sex)) + geom_col() + coord_polar(theta = "y") + xlim(c(0.2, hsize + 0.5))
